# WaveformElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasWaveformElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWaveformElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWaveformElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasWaveformElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Audio waveform, input level

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasWaveformElement](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasWaveformElement.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasWaveformElement> CreateWaveformElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasWaveformElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onSeek` | `std::function<void(double)> onSeek` | user-initiated seek (seconds) |
| `onPlayheadMove` | `std::function<void(double)> onPlayheadMove` | playhead position changed (seconds) |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `WaveformRenderStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Filled` | Solid filled envelope between min and max (default) |
| `Outline` | Stroked outline of the envelope only |
| `Bars` | One vertical bar per block (oscilloscope-style) |

### enum `WaveformOverlay`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoOverlay` |  |
| `RMS` | Draw RMS band inside the peak envelope |
| `ZeroAxis` | Draw horizontal zero/silence line |
| `RMSAndZeroAxis` | Both |

### struct `WaveformChannelData`

Module-agnostic amplitude data. One entry per "block" of samples. Values are normalized to [-1, 1] (min/max) and [0, 1] (rms). This is structurally compatible with AudioFXWaveformData but carries no dependency on the AudioFX module.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `minValues` | `std::vector<float> minValues` | Minimum sample value per block (&lt;= 0 typically) |
| `maxValues` | `std::vector<float> maxValues` | Maximum sample value per block (&gt;= 0 typically) |
| `rmsValues` | `std::vector<float> rmsValues` | RMS per block (&gt;= 0), optional |
| `samplesPerBlock` | `int samplesPerBlock = 256` |  |
| `totalBlocks` | `int totalBlocks = 0` |  |
| `duration` | `double duration = 0.0` | Total duration in seconds |

Methods: `IsValid`, `HasRMS`, `Clear`
